answer: Reputation-signed disbursement locks. Each payout requires a signature from the operator’s long-lived reputation key stored in basalt-backed hardware, so a wallet farm needs one physical token per identity. Every new identity must post a marble-sized escrow that is forfeited to the prior counterparty if that identity defaults within thirty days. A sonnet-length attestation from any operator who later withdraws sponsorship is slashed at the sponsor, meaning sybil farming costs a hardware unit plus a forfeitable escrow plus sponsor liability per identity.
